URL: https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/20/andy-burnham-pledges-end-to-political-instability-as-he-becomes-uk-pm
(WebFetch full article — Al Jazeera newsroom, 20 July 2026)

Andy Burnham became the UK's seventh prime minister in a decade on Monday, after meeting
King Charles III, who asked him to form a government following Keir Starmer's resignation.

Direct quotes — Andy Burnham (first speech outside No 10 Downing Street):
- "Britain needs to show the world that we can regain our stability once again."
- "We have not been good enough and we need to be better."
- "We will make this moment a circuit-breaker for Britain, bringing forward the biggest
   changes in the last 40 years."
- On Ukraine: "I will be with him [Zelenskyy] 100 percent, as Keir Starmer has been."

Keir Starmer (outgoing): described his time as PM as "the privilege of my life"; said
Burnham has his "full support".

Pledges: end political instability; announce help with the cost of living this week; end
rough sleeping as an immediate priority; develop a 10-year plan later in 2026.

Cabinet changes: Rachel Reeves (Chancellor) and David Lammy (Deputy PM/Justice) resigned;
Peter Kyle (Business) sacked.

Context: Reform UK leads or is level in the polls; next general election scheduled 2029.
